samples.summary: Internal-paste path is selected purely by clipboard-text equality, and this delta widens what that path is allowed to destroy (live merge blocks at the cut source)
samples.evidence: `paste()` decides a paste is "internal" with `if (this.copyBuffer && text === this.copyBuffer.text)` (sheet.ts:2234) — the only discriminator is the attacker-influenceable clipboard payload; there is no nonce/identity token on the buffer. Before this delta the internal branch's merge deletions were driven by the copy-buffer snapshot inside `paste()`; the delta moves them into `planPasteMerges` where `liveMergesAmong` (sheet.ts:~2470) resolves the recorded anchors against the LIVE merge map and pushes them into `replaced`, which `applyPasteMerges` then deletes for real, along with clearing covered cells. Vector: a page with clipboard-write access (user gesture) that can guess/replay the serialized copy text — e.g. it was pasted into a chat and copied back — causes a paste the user believes is an external text paste to instead take the cut branch and delete live merged blocks (and their covered-cell contents) at the recorded source coordinates. Impact is limited to the victim's own document (integrity, not confidentiality) and requires exact text match, hence low confidence. Hardening: tag the copy buffer with an opaque token embedded in the clipboard payload (or match on a clipboard item MIME type) rather than raw text equality.
